experiment.description: AI-selected three-center closed-shell cation; generic bounded molecular engine, not dynamics

operation_request.prediction: For this planar C3-symmetric singlet H3+ RHF/cc-pVDZ input, a converged finite total BO energy and3x3 analytic force array are expected. Force sum should be within1e-5 Eh/bohr; equivalent nuclei should have symmetry-related in-plane forces. The radial force sign and energy are deliberately unknown before calculation.
operation_request.falsifier: Nonconvergence, native/resource failure, nonfinite/wrong-shape forces, force sum beyond1e-5 Eh/bohr, invalid source/model/input binding; preserve and STOP, never retry. Symmetry discrepancies are numerical/model diagnostics, not new physics.
operation_request.information_goal: Determine the actual available force response in a generic AI-constructed charged3-center object, and whether another same-object question or a distinct periodic energy-only observation is worth the remaining single slot.

candidate_reasons.reason: Selected: generic three-nucleus charged singlet,2electrons/15AOs, inexpensive; tests charge/electron bookkeeping and vector-force semantics without dedicated molecule code.
Eligible3nuclei10electrons24AOs but larger mean-field problem; offers less additional contract discrimination per resource than the selected charged3-center case.

Eligible and potentially valuable to test distinct periodic energy-only semantics; not selected as first because molecular vector forces expose a richer initial result for an actual subsequent choice. Not precommitted as second.
Always lawful if admission fails or the first observation shows no justified additional experiment.
